hallucinated.context: Tidal volume threshold out of bounds

weaknesses: Expected results are vague and do not verify log content or format
Decision table uses don’t-care values without explicit validation of their neutrality
Only one tidal volume threshold value is tested; increments of 10 ml are not exercised
No tests for simultaneous multiple alarms or concurrent actions
No verification of GUI element existence or state changes beyond action success

artifact:
Decision Table for Alarm Logging and GUI Actions

| Condition 1 | Condition 2 | Condition 3 | Condition 4 | Condition 5 | Action 1 | Action 2 | Action 3 | Action 4 |
|--------------|--------------|--------------|--------------|--------------|----------|----------|----------|----------|
| Alarm Type   | Inhibit?     | Cancel?      | Acknowledge? | Reset?       | Log Alarm | Allow Inhibit | Allow Cancel | Allow Acknowledge |
| Alarm        | Yes          | -            | -            | -            | Yes      | Yes       | -          | -          |
| Alarm        | No           | Yes          | -            | -            | Yes      | -         | Yes        | -          |
| Alarm        | No           | No           | Yes          | -            | Yes      | -         | -          | Yes        |
| Alarm        | No           | No           | No           | Yes          | Yes      | -         | -          | -          |
| Inhibition   | Yes          | -            | -            | -            | Yes      | Yes       | -          | -          |
| Acknowledgement | -        | -            | Yes          | -            | Yes      | -         | -          | Yes        |
| Reset        | -            | -            | -            | Yes          | Yes      | -         | -          | -          |

Notes:
- "Alarm Type" can be "Alarm" or "Inhibition/Cancellation/Acknowledgement/Reset".
- "-" denotes a "don't-care" condition.
- Actions are triggered based on the presence of the respective conditions.

test_cases.title: Log all alarm occurrences
expected: Alarm is logged in the event log

test_cases.title: Log all alarm inhibitions
expected: Inhibition is logged in the event log

test_cases.title: Log all alarm cancellations
expected: Cancellation is logged in the event log

test_cases.title: Log all alarm acknowledgements
expected: Acknowledgement is logged in the event log

test_cases.title: Log all alarm resets
expected: Reset is logged in the event log

test_cases.title: GUI allows inhibiting alarms
expected: Alarm is inhibited

test_cases.title: GUI allows acknowledging alarms
expected: Alarm is acknowledged

test_cases.title: GUI allows cancelling alarms
expected: Alarm is cancelled

test_cases.title: Set alarm on inspiration tidal volume above threshold (80-3000 ml, increments of 10 ml)
preconditions: User specifies tidal volume threshold within bounds
steps: Configure tidal volume threshold in GUI
expected: Alarm triggers when tidal volume exceeds 100 ml

test_cases.title: Alarm fires if PIP > user-specified threshold for 3 consecutive breaths
steps: Simulate breaths with PIP > threshold for 3 breaths
expected: Alarm fires after 3 consecutive breaths exceeding threshold

test_cases.title: Alarm fires if leakage > user-specified threshold (5-150 lpm)
expected: Alarm fires when leakage exceeds threshold

test_cases.title: Boundary test for tidal volume threshold at lower limit (80 ml)
preconditions: User sets tidal volume threshold to 80 ml
steps: Configure tidal volume threshold to 80 ml
expected: No alarm triggers at exact lower limit

test_cases.title: Boundary test for tidal volume threshold at upper limit (3000 ml)
preconditions: User sets tidal volume threshold to 3000 ml
steps: Configure tidal volume threshold to 3000 ml
expected: No alarm triggers at exact upper limit

test_cases.title: Boundary test for PIP threshold
steps: Simulate PIP at 30 cmH2O for 3 breaths
expected: No alarm fires at exact threshold

test_cases.title: Boundary test for leakage threshold at lower limit (5 lpm)
preconditions: User sets leakage threshold to 5 lpm
expected: No alarm triggers at exact lower limit

test_cases.title: Boundary test for leakage threshold at upper limit (150 lpm)
preconditions: User sets leakage threshold to 150 lpm
expected: No alarm triggers at exact upper limit

test_cases.title: Negative path: Attempt to inhibit non-existent alarm
expected: Inhibition fails, no alarm logged

test_cases.title: Negative path: Attempt to acknowledge non-existent alarm
expected: Acknowledgement fails, no alarm logged

test_cases.title: Negative path: Attempt to cancel non-existent alarm
expected: Cancellation fails, no alarm logged

test_cases.title: Negative path: Set tidal volume threshold outside specified bounds
preconditions: User attempts to set threshold outside 80-3000 ml
steps: Attempt to configure tidal volume threshold to 4000 ml
expected: Configuration fails, threshold not set
